card.name: Linking words before minority or abuse-risk terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, of, on) and the word youth that come right before a group or risk term. Seen in 'women and minority', 'youth of color', and 'history of substance abuse'.

modes.label: Equity and race phrases
modes.description: A linking word or 'youth' just before 'minority' or 'of color' in text about education and diversity.
modes.example: recruitment and advancement of women<< and>> minority faculty throughout the Institute.

modes.label: Risk and history phrases
modes.description: The word 'of' after risks, history, or signs, before abuse or allergy terms in drug labels.
